gap: No result ChatGPT got states which of the roughly 2 kWh stations under $1,000 can take a second battery later: EcoFlow's US store attaches "2-10kWh Expandable Capacity" only to the $1,149 DELTA 3 Max Plus, not the $879 DELTA 3 Max, while DJI documents up to 10 expansion batteries (22,528 Wh) for the Power 2000 but routes solar through a separately sold adapter (400 W via the MPPT module).
standout_why: Compared against four pages I opened on 2026-11-27. outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000 (cited) says only that the Anker C2000 Gen 2 "takes add-on batteries"; it names no battery and gives no solar voltage, alternator charger or 240 V detail. PopSci's Black Friday roundup (cited) says the BP1000 is not compatible with the C1000 Gen 2 and describes BLUETTI Charger 1 (560 W) and Charger 2 (1,200 W), but says nothing on DELTA 3 Max or DJI expansion. outagereadyhq.com's under-$1,000 page lists DELTA 3 Max expandability as "Not stated". thewattlist.com covers expansion only for 1 kWh units. None gives a solar input voltage window for any unit. Business Insider and Popular Mechanics (both cited) could not be opened from this tool, so they are not compared; that is why this is 2, not 3. The EcoFlow finding is also read from how the store's listing text assigns features, not from an explicit "not expandable" sentence.
decides: It does not overturn a capacity-per-dollar ranking, but it splits the pick by what the buyer adds later. ChatGPT's first pick, the DELTA 3 Max at $879, is shown by EcoFlow without the expansion feature it gives the Max Plus, which is over budget at $1,149. The DJI Power 2000 is the one candidate with maker-documented expansion that I confirmed, but a solar buyer must add a DJI adapter (400 W via the MPPT module, or the 1.8 kW charger). The BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 wins the charge-from-the-vehicle segment under $1,000: BLUETTI's store sells it with the Charger 1 alternator charger at $929.99. Its own expansion answer and solar window were not sourced today, so the page should not call it expandable or non-expandable until the manual is read.
